title: Effect of hydrothermal treatment on plutonium retention in deep liquid radioactive waste disposal
content:
Environ. Sci.: Processes Impacts, 2025, 27,1003-1012
DOI: 10.1039/D4EM00516C, Paper
Tolganay B. Egorova, Anna Yu Romanchuk, Alexander V. Egorov, Alexander L. Trigub, Elena V. Zakharova, Anna G. Volkova, Andrey A. Zubkov, Irina E. Vlasova, Stepan N. Kalmykov
Pu behavior under conditions of injection of acidic liquid radioactive waste into a deep permeable disposal was laboratory simulated. Rapid Pu sorption in the nearest zone, slow leaching and resorption on fresh disposal sand were demonstrated.
